title: Latest: 5-18 Nov 2026
md:
# Data protection – Consent Manager framework (13 Nov 2026)
- **Consent Manager registration framework** under the **Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023** came into force on **13 Nov 2026**; **MeitY Secretary S. Krishnan** launched the online portal of the **Data Protection Board of India (DPBI)** – **dpbi.gov.in**.
- Applications are assessed by the DPBI under **Rule 4 of the DPDP Rules, 2025**; **Section 6(9)** (consent managers must register with the Board) and **Section 27(1)(d)** (Board's power to act on breaches) took effect the same day; minimum **net worth ₹2 crore**.
- A **Consent Manager** is a registered entity that lets a person give, manage, review and withdraw consent to a data fiduciary through one interoperable platform; the remaining DPDP provisions are due by **May 2027**.
# Supreme Court and quasi-judicial rulings
- **[16 Nov 2026] Rotation of reserved seats (Maharashtra)**: a bench of **Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana** dismissed an appeal against **Rule XII** of the **Maharashtra Zilla Parishads and Panchayat Samitis (Manner and Rotation of Reservation of Seats) Rules, 2025** (first general election after the Rules = first election for rotation); held that **no voter or candidate has a vested right** to have a constituency reserved for SCs/STs - a **policy matter**; the **Bombay High Court (Nagpur bench)** had dismissed the challenge on 19 Sep 2025.
  - Background: **Article 243D** - reservation of seats for SCs/STs (in proportion to population) and **one-third for women** in Panchayats, **allotted by rotation**; **Article 243T** - the same for Municipalities.
# Elections and legislatures
- **Ladakh hill councils**: polling for **all eight Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Councils (LAHDCs)** - **100 constituencies** - on **4 Dec 2026**, process to end by **8 Dec**; councils extended from Leh and Kargil to all **eight districts** by the **LAHDC (Amendment) Regulation, 2026** promulgated by the **President**; Kargil observed a shutdown against winter polls; panchayat and Leh/Kargil municipal council polls on **21 Nov 2026**.
- **Rajya Sabha bypoll (Madhya Pradesh)**: Union Minister **Hardeep Singh Puri** declared **elected unopposed** on **5 Nov 2026** (last day of withdrawal) to the seat vacated by **L. Murugan** (resigned **14 Oct 2026**; term was to run to 3 Apr 2030); Puri's UP Rajya Sabha term was ending on **25 Nov 2026**; oath administered by **Rajya Sabha Chairman C. P. Radhakrishnan** (the Vice-President is ex officio Chairman - **Art 64**).
- **Uttar Pradesh electoral roll**: ECI published the integrated **draft roll for all 403 Assembly constituencies** on **17 Nov 2026** (deferred from 12 Nov); **claims and objections 17 Nov – 16 Dec 2026**; **final roll 4 Jan 2027**.
- **Commonwealth Women Parliamentarians (CWP) India Region Conference**: the **first standalone** such conference in India, **Vidhana Soudha, Bengaluru**, opened by **Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla** on **17 Nov 2026**; organised by the **Karnataka Legislature with Parliament**; CWP India Region chaired by **D. Purandeswari**; UN Women side event on menopause.
  - Birla recalled the **Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, 2023** (**106th Amendment**) - **33% reservation for women** in the **Lok Sabha and State Assemblies**.
# Governance reforms
- **PM's Awards for Excellence in Public Administration 2026**: **DARPG** opened the web portal (**pmawards.gov.in**) on **13 Nov 2026**; **16 awards in three categories** - Holistic Development of Districts, Aspirational Blocks Programme, Innovations; **nine schemes newly added**; achievements of **1 Apr 2024 – 30 Nov 2026** considered; awards presented on **Civil Services Day (21 April)**.
- **[13 Nov 2026] Raniwas Mound, Kesariya (East Champaran, Bihar)** declared an **archaeological site of national importance** under the **AMASR Act, 1958** by the **Ministry of Culture (ASI)** - Buddhist monastery and a terracotta sealing showing a tiered stupa; **Alexander Cunningham** explored the area in **1861**.
> ⚠ Trap: Consent-manager rules sit in the **DPDP Act 2023 / DPDP Rules 2025** (Board = **DPBI**), not the IT Act 2000; SC/ST seat rotation in Panchayats is under **Art 243D** (Municipalities **243T**); LAHDC polls are in **all eight** Ladakh districts on **4 Dec 2026**.

title: Latest: 5-18 Nov 2026
md:
# WPI inflation - October 2026 (released 16 Nov 2026)
- **WPI inflation, Oct 2026: 12.29%** (provisional), up from **11.39%** in Sep 2026 - **highest in the new WPI series (base 2022-23)**; all-commodities index **113.3** (Sep 112.5); third straight monthly rise.
- **Fuel and power 32.84%** (Sep 25.85%) - main driver; **primary articles 9.24%**; **manufactured products 9.54%** (Sep 9.76%); **WPI Food Index 8.58%** (Sep 8.66%).
- WPI is compiled by the **Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT (Ministry of Commerce and Industry)**; next release (Nov 2026 WPI) on **14 Dec 2026**.
> ⚠ Trap: Oct 2026 **WPI 12.29%** vs Oct 2026 **CPI 6.09%** (NSO); WPI is by the **Commerce Ministry (OEA, DPIIT)**, CPI by **MoSPI**.
# Trade - October 2026 (released 13 Nov 2026)
- **Merchandise exports $49.47 bn** (**+45.06%** from $34.11 bn) - an **all-time monthly high**; **merchandise imports $89.35 bn** (record); **goods trade deficit $39.88 bn** - a **one-year high**.
- **Services exports $40.51 bn**, services surplus **$19.79 bn**; **total exports (goods + services) $89.99 bn (+29.9%)**; overall trade deficit **$20.09 bn**.
- **April-October 2026-27**: total exports **$568.84 bn (+16.66%)**; merchandise deficit **$218.15 bn**; petroleum products (+140%) and electronics (+62.7%) led; Commerce Secretary **Rajesh Agrawal**.
# Jobs data - PLFS monthly bulletin, October 2026 (19th)
- **Unemployment rate (15+, CWS) 4.9%** in Oct 2026 (Sep **5.0%**; Oct 2025 **5.2%**); **rural 4.2%**, **urban 6.7%** (from 6.9%); female UR 5.0%, male 4.9%.
- **LFPR 55.7%** (Sep 55.5%), **WPR 53.0%** (Sep 52.7%), **female LFPR 35.0%**; PLFS by the **NSO, MoSPI**.
# Forex reserves and growth forecasts
- **Forex reserves: $719.55 bn** (week ended **6 Nov 2026**, **+$2.49 bn**); FCA **$591.35 bn**; **gold $104.80 bn** (+$2.2 bn); all-time high **$785.7 bn** (week ended **4 Sep 2026**); data by the **RBI** (weekly statistical supplement).
- **Moody's Global Macro Outlook 2027-28 (11 Nov 2026)**: India's **FY27 growth raised to 7.0% from 6.5%**; growth near **7%** over the medium term (7% in 2028); RBI's own FY27 estimate **7.1%**.
- **SBI Research (Ecowrap)**: **Q2 FY27 GDP growth ~7.8%** (RBI estimate 7.2%), **GVA 8-8.2%**, from a **dynamic factor model of 54 high-frequency indicators**; official Q2 data due **30 Nov 2026**.
- **Pre-Budget 2027-28**: FM **Nirmala Sitharaman** held the **first pre-Budget consultation with economists** on **16 Nov 2026**; Budget expected **1 Feb 2027** - her **10th consecutive** Budget.
# Financial-sector regulation
- **IFSCA (13 Nov 2026)**: the Finance Ministry (DEA) notified **"commodity trading contract" as a financial product** and **commodity trading as a financial service** under the **IFSCA Act, 2019** - to make **GIFT City IFSC** a global commodity-trading hub (trade now routed via Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, Switzerland); **IFSCA**: est. **27 Apr 2020**, HQ **GIFT City, Gandhinagar**.
- **RBI (Domestic Money Transfer) Directions, 2026** (11 Nov 2026): a **walk-in customer** without an account can remit **up to ₹50,000 in cash** to a beneficiary's bank account via **NEFT**; consolidate the 2011 and 2024 instructions; banks to run velocity checks and credit alerts.
- **RBI Master Directions on Cyber Resilience and Digital Payment Security Controls for non-bank PSOs, 2026** (5 Nov 2026) - under **Sections 10(2) and 18, Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007**; cyber incidents to be reported to **RBI and CERT-In within 6 hours**; small PSOs get time till **1 Apr 2028**.
- **Paytm Payments Services Ltd (PPSL)** got RBI **in-principle authorisation** (letter of **13 Nov 2026**) to issue **prepaid payment instruments (wallets)**; a system audit report is due **within 6 months** or the approval lapses; RBI had **cancelled Paytm Payments Bank's licence on 24 Apr 2026**.
- **UPI Vyapaar Saksham Scheme** (**NPCI** circular, **11 Nov 2026**): for **small merchants (turnover up to ₹40 lakh)**, mainly **Tier III-VI towns, the North-East, J&K and Ladakh**; acquiring banks get **₹300 per QR code** and **₹750 per soundbox**; funded by **5% of UPI MDR** collections; three components (**30% / 50% / 20%**); runs **3 years**.
# Markets and municipal finance
- **NCDEX-BigMint steel scrap futures** (11 Nov 2026): **India's first Price Reporting Agency (PRA)-based** steel scrap futures - **Heavy Melting Scrap (HMS) 80:20**, lot **10 tonnes**, **cash-settled**; India's crude steel output **168.4 mt (FY26)**.
- **Patna Municipal Corporation** became the **first ULB in Bihar** to list **municipal bonds on the NSE** - about **₹199.99 crore**, coupon **9.20%**, **10-year** tenure (placement 30 Oct 2026).
> ⚠ Trap: the **one-year-high goods deficit** of Oct 2026 is **$39.88 bn** (overall incl. services **$20.09 bn**); UPI Vyapaar Saksham is an **NPCI** scheme funded by **MDR**, not the Budget; the walk-in NEFT cash limit is **₹50,000**.
~~ Sources: ddindia.co.in 16 Nov 2026 (WPI Oct 2026); cracktarget.com 16 Nov 2026 (next WPI 14 Dec); swarajyamag.com 13 Nov 2026 (trade Oct 2026); cracktarget.com 14 Nov 2026 (Apr-Oct deficit, sectors); MoSPI PLFS monthly press note Oct 2026 and theprint.in (PLFS); newsonair.gov.in 13 Nov 2026 and freepressjournal.in (forex; all-time high); newsonair.gov.in 11 Nov 2026 and theprint.in (Moody's); knnindia.co.in and devdiscourse.com (SBI Ecowrap); newsonair.gov.in 16 Nov 2026 and newsbytesapp (pre-Budget); angelone.in, corplawupdates.in, affairscloud.com 15-16 Nov 2026 (IFSCA notifications); rbi.org.in Master Directions id=13752, dailypioneer.com (DMT Directions); affairscloud.com 12 Nov 2026 and vinodkothari.com (cyber resilience directions); freepressjournal.in and theweek.in 13 Nov 2026 (Paytm PPSL); adda247 and inc42.com (UPI Vyapaar Saksham); affairscloud.com 13 Nov 2026 (NCDEX-BigMint); affairscloud.com 12 Nov 2026 (Patna bonds).

md:
# Janjatiya Gaurav Divas - 15 Nov 2026
- **Janjatiya Gaurav Divas** (observed since **2021**) on **15 Nov 2026** - **151st birth anniversary of Bhagwan Birsa Munda**; culmination of **Janjatiya Gaurav Pakhwada** (from **1 Nov**).
- PM **Narendra Modi** addressed the main event at **Gadchiroli (Maharashtra)** by video and launched **246 tribal development projects worth about ₹3,000 crore** - education (incl. **Eklavya Model Residential Schools**), health, livelihood, **PM-JANMAN multi-purpose centres**; CM Devendra Fadnavis and Tribal Affairs Minister **Jual Oram** present.
- Schemes behind them: **PM-JANMAN** (launched **15 Nov 2023**, for **PVTGs**) and **Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan (DAJGUA)**; over **₹1 lakh crore** allocated to the two.
- **Forest Rights Act, 2006** (in force **31 Dec 2007**, nodal **Ministry of Tribal Affairs**): about **54 lakh claims** by 31 Aug 2026, **80.64% disposed**; **25.42 lakh titles** over ~**238 lakh acres**; a **National FRA Digital Platform** was launched during the Pakhwada.
# Women, elderly and rural livelihoods
- **Lakhpati Didi** (under **DAY-NRLM**, Ministry of Rural Development): **3.76 crore** SHG women became Lakhpati Didis by **June 2026**; target **6 crore by March 2029**; a Lakhpati Didi = SHG member with household income of **at least ₹1 lakh a year**.
- **IIM Ahmedabad evaluation** of Lakhpati Didi (**6,531 respondents, 17 States/UTs**): average monthly household **income +61%**, **savings +61.7%**.
- **AVYAY in Cantonments** (MoU, **16 Nov 2026**, New Delhi): **Department of Social Justice and Empowerment** and the **Directorate General Defence Estates (DGDE, MoD)** - senior-citizen schemes of the **Atal Vayo Abhyudaya Yojana (AVYAY)** extended to **Cantonment Boards**: Day Care Centres, **25- or 50-bed Senior Citizen Homes**, geriatric caregiver training; witnessed by **Rajnath Singh** and **Dr Virendra Kumar**; follows the **Vayo Samman Rashtriya Abhiyan (4 Nov 2026)**; 60+ population ~**10 crore (2011) → ~23 crore (2036)**.
- **PMEGP**: MSME Minister **Jitan Ram Manjhi** released **₹1,000 crore margin money subsidy** for **11,333 new micro enterprises** (Oct 2026); PMEGP launched **August 2008**, implemented by **KVIC** (Ministry of MSME).
- **Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat**: **100-week** campaign of **MY Bharat** (Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports) with NSS; launched **2 Aug 2026**; de-addiction helpline **14446**.
# State schemes and initiatives
- **Himachal Pradesh - CM Apna Parivar Sukhi Parivar Yojana**: **₹1,500 a month** for eligible women aged **18-59**, plus **300 free electricity units** a month to beneficiary households; aid for women above 59 raised from ₹1,050 to ₹1,500; also **Khelo Himachal Chitta Mukt Abhiyan-2026** (anti-drug, all 12 districts).
- **Odisha**: CM **Mohan Charan Majhi** opened **robotics labs in 807 schools** (Classes 6-10) and launched the **NIPUN app** (foundational reading and numeracy) at **Surabhi-2026**, Bhubaneswar.
- **Mizoram-SBI MoU** (10 Nov 2026): Village Councils to collect own-source revenue digitally via the **SAMARTH Panchayat Portal** (under the **Mizoram Village Council Act, 2025**) - **first North-East State** and **third in India** to sign such an MoU.
- **Mizoram Universal Healthcare Scheme (MUHCS)**: ADB released the **first tranche of $21.6 mn** of a **$108 mn results-based loan**; Centre passed **₹205.49 crore** to the State (**90% grant, 10% loan**); MUHCS gives cashless cover **up to ₹5 lakh a year** (from **1 Apr 2025**).
> ⚠ Trap: Janjatiya Gaurav Divas = **15 Nov** (Birsa Munda), observed since **2021**; PM-JANMAN is for **PVTGs** (launched 15 Nov 2023); Lakhpati Didi target is **6 crore by March 2029**; PMEGP is implemented by **KVIC**.
~~ Sources: uniindia.com 15 Nov 2026, newsonair.gov.in 15 Nov 2026, pmindia.gov.in (Janjatiya Gaurav Divas, 246 projects, ₹3,000 crore); cracktarget.com 15 Nov 2026 (₹1 lakh crore PM-JANMAN + DAJGUA); cracktarget.com 16 Nov 2026 (FRA backgrounder); sarkariyojana.com and prokerala.com (Lakhpati Didi 3.76 crore, 6 crore target, IIM-A study); newsonair.gov.in 16 Nov 2026 and deccanchronicle.com (AVYAY-DGDE MoU); affairscloud.com 17 Nov 2026 (population 60+); affairscloud.com 12 Nov 2026 (PMEGP; Mizoram-SBI MoU); cracktarget.com 15 Nov 2026 (Nasha Mukt Yuva, 14446); affairscloud.com 15-16 Nov 2026 (HP scheme; Odisha robotics labs, NIPUN); affairscloud.com 11 Nov 2026 (MUHCS ADB tranche).

title: Latest: 5-18 Nov 2026
md:
# New committees (Nov 2026)
- **MYAS committee on sports leagues** (announced **18 Nov 2026**): **14-member** panel of the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** to frame a "**wider, professionally managed and financially sustainable**" sports-league ecosystem; convener **Kunal, Joint Secretary (Governance), Department of Sports**; members include **Raghuram Iyer (CEO, IOA)**, **Hemang Amin (COO, IPL)**, Vineel Krishna (JS, Khelo India), sports-law expert **Nandan Kamath** and broadcasters (JioHotstar, Sony, DD Sports, Zee).
  - Mandate: priority sports (Olympic, **women's**, youth, **indigenous**, emerging), operating models, **Viability Gap Funding**, concessional use of government stadia, corporate/franchise/CSR capital, links with schools, colleges and clubs, governance and athlete welfare; report in **eight weeks**.
- **High-Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat** (chair **Suresh N. Patel**, former CVC; set up 30 Oct 2026, six-month tenure) began **stakeholder consultations** on banking reforms on **18 Nov 2026**.
- **IRDAI working groups on Risk-Based Capital (RBC)** (order of **10 Nov 2026**): separate **life (13 members, convener Jamuna Choudhary)** and **non-life (12 members, convener Parmeshwar Shelke)** groups with insurers, **Munich Re, Swiss Re** and the **Institute of Actuaries of India**; to give an **exposure draft of RBC regulations**, an approach paper and a reporting template **within a month**; aim - shift from the **factor-based solvency** regime to **risk-based capital aligned with Ind AS**.
  - **IRDAI**: statutory body under the **IRDA Act, 1999**; HQ **Hyderabad**.
- **IFSCA expert committee** (constituted **2024**) had recommended a dedicated framework for **commodity trading through GIFT IFSC** - implemented by the Finance Ministry's notifications of **13 Nov 2026** under the IFSCA Act, 2019.
# Regulators and quasi-judicial bodies
- **NCDRC** (orders of **12 Nov 2026**) dismissed two appeals of **Weblink.In Pvt Ltd (ExportersIndia.com)** and upheld **CCPA** penalties of **₹10 lakh each (₹20 lakh in all)** for listing **ammonium nitrate, PETN and picric acid** (regulated under the **Explosives Act, 1884**) without due diligence; a platform hosting such ads **cannot hide behind intermediary status**; Dial4Trade and Just Dial were also fined ₹10 lakh each.
  - **CCPA**: set up **24 July 2020** under the **Consumer Protection Act, 2019** (Ministry of Consumer Affairs); **NCDRC** hears appeals against CCPA orders; National Consumer Helpline **1915**.
- **Press Council of India - National Press Day (16 Nov 2026)**: **60 years** of the PCI (began functioning **16 Nov 1966**); theme reported as "**Journalism: Populist or Responsible?**".
- **PPVFRA - 22nd Foundation Day**: marked the **Silver Jubilee (25 years) of the PPV&FR Act, 2001**; addressed by **Dr P. K. Mishra** (Principal Secretary to the PM); PPVFRA est. **2005**, statutory, **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**, HQ **New Delhi**.
  - **Plant Genome Saviour Awards**: **5 community awards (₹10 lakh each)**, **10 farmer rewards (₹1.5 lakh)**, **20 farmer recognitions (₹1 lakh)** a year; India has **22 agro-biodiversity hotspots**; **Koraput (Odisha)** - FAO **GIAHS** (2012).
> ⚠ Trap: the sports-league panel is of **MYAS** (not BCCI) and reports in **8 weeks**; RBC working groups are of **IRDAI** (HQ **Hyderabad**); CCPA penalties go in appeal to the **NCDRC**; PCI turned **60** in 2026.
~~ Sources: ianslive.in 18 Nov 2026 (MYAS committee); business-standard.com and tribuneindia.com 18 Nov 2026 (banking committee consultations); psuwatch.com, insurancebusinessmag.com, affairscloud.com 12 Nov 2026 (IRDAI working groups); affairscloud.com 15-16 Nov 2026 (IFSCA expert committee; PPVFRA; Plant Genome Saviour Awards); businesstoday.in 16 Nov 2026 and cracktarget.com 16 Nov 2026 (NCDRC-CCPA); sentinelassam.com, sanskritiias.com and affairscloud.com 17 Nov 2026 (National Press Day 2026, theme - PCI's own site not yet updated).

title: Latest: 5-18 Nov 2026
md:
# NITI Aayog - "Impact Assessment of PLI Schemes" (Nov 2026)
- Mid-course review of **all 14 PLI schemes** by **NITI Aayog**, with **IIM Ahmedabad** as knowledge partner; by **March 2026**, **58%** of the combined implementation period had elapsed.
- Against full-tenure targets: **investment ₹2.4 lakh crore (76%)**, **production and sales ₹22.66 lakh crore (64%)**, **employment only 28%**; incentives disbursed **₹35,354 crore (18.51%)** of the **₹1.91 lakh crore** outlay.
- About **70% of targeted segments** on track in four sectors - **large-scale electronics, pharma drugs, telecom and networking, food products**; MSME gains uneven; flags thin export and job data.
# National Health Accounts Estimates 2023-24 (15 Nov 2026)
- Released by the **Union Health Ministry**; **11th round** of NHA, prepared by the **NHA Technical Secretariat (NHATS) at NHSRC**.
- **Government health expenditure ₹4.14 lakh crore** (₹1.30 lakh crore in 2013-14); **per capita GHE ₹2,959** (₹1,042); government share of THE up **14.9 points** in a decade.
- **Out-of-pocket expenditure 42.7% of THE** (**64.2%** in 2013-14; **43.4%** in 2022-23); **social security** share **6% → 11%**; **private health insurance 3.4% → 10.2%**; primary-care spending ~₹1.53 lakh crore.
# Economy rankings and outlooks
- **ASSOCHAM - "India's Economic Edge in the Top Ten Economies"** (12-13 Nov 2026): **India 1st** in economic resilience for **2026-30** with **71/100**; **China 66**, **Japan and Russia 60** each, Germany 59, **US last (36)**; based on **IMF WEO** data, **10 macro indicators**; India was **3rd** (66) in the 2021-25 assessment (Russia 74, China 71).
- **Goldman Sachs Global Economic Outlook 2027** (15 Nov 2026): **India 7.2% in 2027** (7.9% in 2026) - **fastest-growing major economy**; **China 4.5%**; **world 2.8%**; global AI investment seen at **$1.8 trillion in 2027**.
- **PLFS Quarterly Bulletin, July-September 2026** (NSO, MoSPI, **10 Nov 2026**; 6th rural + urban quarterly): unemployment **5.1%** (from **5.4%** in Apr-Jun), **LFPR 55.5%**, **WPR 52.7%**; rural UR **4.3%**; urban male 6.1%, urban female 8.8%.
# Global reports with an India angle
- **TOP500 - 68th list** (**16 Nov 2026**, **SC26, Chicago**): **LineShine (China) No. 1** again (first Chinese leader since Sunway TaihuLight), ahead of **El Capitan, Frontier, Aurora (US)** and **JUPITER Booster (Germany)**; India's best - **Shakti Cloud (Yotta Data Services) 35th** (32nd in Jun 2026); new entrants only **27**, the lowest ever.
- **WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026** (12 Nov 2026): world **10.6 million** TB cases and **1.13 million** deaths in 2025; **India ~25% of cases and 23% of deaths** - then **Indonesia 10%**, **Philippines 6.8%**, China 6.5%, Pakistan 6.4%; WHO **withheld India's incidence estimate** pending review of new district-level data (update in **early 2027**).
> ⚠ Trap: PLI employment reached only **28%** of target (investment **76%**); NHA OOPE **42.7%** is for **2023-24** (43.4% was 2022-23); ASSOCHAM ranks India **1st** for **2026-30** but **3rd** for 2021-25; TOP500 No. 1 is **LineShine (China)**, India's best **35th**.
~~ Sources: theprint.in and niti.gov.in "Impact Assessment of PLI Schemes" (Nov 2026); affairscloud.com 14 Nov 2026 (14 sectors, 58%, four sectors on track); theprint.in 15 Nov 2026 (NHA 2023-24, 11th round, NHATS/NHSRC); thehansindia.com and knnindia.co.in 13 Nov 2026 (ASSOCHAM scores); affairscloud.com 17 Nov 2026 (ASSOCHAM 2021-25; Goldman AI investment); telanganatoday.com 15 Nov 2026 and newsbytesapp (Goldman Sachs 7.2%, China 4.5%, world 2.8%); MoSPI PLFS QB press note Jul-Sep 2026 and affairscloud.com 12 Nov 2026 (PLFS quarterly); top500.org Nov 2026 list (fetched; ranks 1-10 and Shakti Cloud 35) and top500.org/site/51112 (Jun 2026 rank 32); kpiasacademy.com 18 Nov 2026 (27 new entrants); thesouthfirst.com 14 Nov 2026 and thewire.in (WHO TB Report 2026).
